title: Sum of k-Mirror Numbers
goal: Sum the first n positive numbers palindromic in decimal and base k.
strategy: Generate decimal palindromes directly by mirroring their first half, in increasing numeric order. Convert each to base k and keep only representations that are also palindromes.
